authority.rule: Same campaign id, world seed, exact place and campaign instant must produce exactly the same environment snapshot. Environment derivation may not write campaign state.

separation_invariants: Static place kind and authored terrain are not transient weather.
Derived environment may modify only registered travel and TerrainState channels unless another exact rules owner explicitly consumes a channel.
Derived weather does not own mutable fire, smoke, flooding works, patrols, office hours, staffing, mission intelligence, tracking evidence, scent rules, chakra behavior, or technique effects.
A weather transition does not by itself create a player wake or scheduler event.
Player-safe context exposes current-location environment only unless another read lawfully authorizes a different place.
Narration may not invent additional weather bonuses, penalties, clues, tracks, chakra interactions, or hidden actors.
